title: Workspace support probe: a 404 on server-info is not proof of 'no workspaces'; fall back to server-features
answers: workspace support detection falls back to server-features when server-info is 404
Active workspace cannot be used error against a workspace-aware legacy server
how does MLflow decide the server supports workspaces when /server-info is missing
body:
Symptom: a user with a workspace-aware legacy MLflow server (or a wrong URI path prefix) gets workspace support treated as off, or sees 'Active workspace ... cannot be used' with no hint about the URI.
Root cause: mlflow/store/workspace_rest_store_mixin.py:WorkspaceRestStoreMixin._probe_workspace_support used to return False on any 404 from SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT and never queried the legacy SERVER_FEATURES_ENDPOINT.
Fix pattern: on a 404 from server-info, query server-features via mlflow/utils/server_info.py:_fetch_server_features. Only if that is also 404 raise INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE with the 'verify configured MLflow URI and path prefix' guidance.
Constraints: only an explicit workspaces_enabled=false keeps the FEATURE_DISABLED path. Non-404 errors from either endpoint raise (TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE / INTERNAL_ERROR), not fall back. _fetch_server_features is not cached; only fetch_server_info goes through _SERVER_INFO_CACHE.
applies: Workspace capability probing in the REST tracking and model-registry stores; not for non-workspace server-info consumers.
says: Connecting to our older server displays an error saying the active workspace cannot be used.
Legacy servers with workspaces enabled are incorrectly detected as not supporting workspace features.
Workspaces appear disabled when connecting to an older backend deployment.
Entering an incorrect server URL path prefix shows no hint about checking the address.
search: Workspace capability probing in WorkspaceRestStoreMixin._probe_workspace_support must query server-features via mlflow/utils/server_info.py:_fetch_server_features when SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT returns a 404, rather than treating workspace support as disabled. If server-features also returns 404, raise INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE with guidance to verify the configured MLflow URI and path prefix. Only an explicit workspaces_enabled=false triggers the FEATURE_DISABLED path, non-404 errors raise TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE or INTERNAL_ERROR without falling back, and _fetch_server_features is uncached unlike _SERVER_INFO_CACHE. This applies to REST tracking and model-registry stores, but not to non-workspace server-info consumers.
